B_contract.catalog_endorsement: The native tool-call bundle explicitly selects every catalog and adopts that exact current set; no absent-slot fallback, implicit inheritance or host choice. A direct reference preserves original candidate authorship and is final-author adoption, not new final-author research.
B_contract.rendering: Validate complete JSON, exact keys/types, explicit adoption, role-compatible references, hashes, UTF-8, syntactically valid catalog JSON and existing limits. Copy chosen reference bytes unchanged; emit inline strings verbatim. Do not summarize, fill fields, invent mappings/receipts, correct claims or merge catalogs.
B_contract.atomicity: Stage the complete four-file set under the confined fresh output parent, fsync and publish as one directory commit. Reject conflicting/preexisting canonical output, partial/malformed input, drift or incomplete commit. Return success only for the actual committed complete set, with its hashes. Never alias/copy into old failed or frozen outputs.
B_contract.native_completion: For the ordinary opted-in final role, the existing writer returns the materialization receipt before the native author can complete its assigned delivery Goal. Actual native COMPLETE receipt, artifact commit, owned quiescence and source grade remain separate. Host cannot set/fabricate native COMPLETE or infer full useful/semantic coverage from valid serialization.
B_contract.public_provenance: Publish exact bundle/native-call and input-manifest hashes, each canonical output hash, original role/job/Goal and original status, plus final native adopter. For copied inputs mark inherited unchanged and that the host did not verify semantic alignment. Keep administrative receipt separate from authored catalog bytes; no new source facts or case-specific warnings.

current_limits_unchanged.time_memory_CPU_output_and_EOF_cleanup: Existing exact job/tool/resource clocks and caps apply, including transient assembly and retained helpers; no reserve waiver or later deadline

method_fidelity.V01: Preserve actual matched/source tools and the declared physical execution-access difference (four control tools / five treatment tools where configured). No sixth tool or implicit execution on either arm.
method_fidelity.V05: Only its designated final_resolution produces out/final. Revision remains out/revision and retains its existing stage/path allocation unless separately prospectively versioned; do not collapse flash/resolution roles.
method_fidelity.V06: Keep native amendment-first authorship and the already-declared strict zero-fuzz host renderer. Do not force a full rewrite or add a new per-block parser. Initial generic final-writer profile may exclude V06; its existing method remains runnable. A V06 transport version may combine explicit catalog adoption with the existing base/patch renderer only when the exact method-specific objective and byte-preserving input/output paths are pinned. Native patch-stage completion is not a fabricated assembled-final receipt; complete delivery is counted only after its existing renderer actually finishes all required files.
method_fidelity.V08: Combined critic/final must still perform checking and supported correction and deliver all four; a review-only map is insufficient. Same bundle structure as its control, with unchanged 1500 vs900/600 roles.
method_fidelity.V16: Keep native normal vs concise decision-focused writing and its separate structured lead/history inventory. Host supplies no summary, hides no required meaning in catalogs and does not force padding.

C_alternative: Prompt-only instruction to commit the three catalogs before long proposal serialization is permissible only as a separately frozen stage-scoped version after method-required checking/repair, preserving V06 amendment-first and V16 delivery factors. It is not the selected primary remedy, has no demonstrated efficacy, and is not an automatic fallback/retry after viewing quality results.

prospective_use.eligible: Wholly unstarted new declared repair/resource versions; same transport/role format in both arms for new matched credit. Leave all frozen/live/original jobs unchanged.
prospective_use.inputs: DEC007 first compatible chronological immutable same-arm roles; genuine completed critics reused when compatible. No best-output/grade selection, cross-arm/confirmation feedback or Sol source answers.
prospective_use.finite_assignment: One concrete bundle-delivery repair version, under each original source card role cap (for example final600); maintain durable original deadlines/status and record all new costs separately and cumulatively. Do not reset/extend original budgets, allocate unused outer5400 as extra time or auto-loop identical jobs.
prospective_use.counting: Original failures, Goal states, source grades and costs remain. Recovered/warm actual full delivery is labeled in its new lineage; it is not a retroactive original PASS or fresh matched pipeline. Locked confirmation criteria/topology/caps remain; outside-allowance recovery does not become locked completion. A declared common mechanical confirmation repetition uses fresh matched controls and no prior source-quality answers.

minimum_mechanical_evidence_before_opt_i: Real existing writer API accepts native-shaped inline and reference bundles; exact output hashes/provenance and unchanged tool catalog/cardinality are shown.
Missing/duplicate/unknown fields, absent explicit adoption, wrong role/stage/arm, stale hashes, malformed catalog JSON and invalid UTF-8 fail closed with no complete publication.
Reference closure denies arbitrary/private/evaluator/cross-arm paths, traversal, symlinks/hardlinks and unstable inputs under existing confinement.
Truncation, process loss, conflicting output and interrupted/late commit cannot publish or acknowledge an incomplete four-file set; only a full committed set gets success.
Existing byte/file/time/memory/CPU/EOF and owned-cleanup limits include assembly and fail without budget extension; replay cannot overwrite an already committed version.
Method role/path fixtures preserve V05/V08/V16; any opted-in V06 uses only the already-declared exact zero-fuzz mechanism and rejects mismatched patches.
implementation_admission: Source/engine/case/ops owners freeze actual source/profile/input closure and matched packets before dispatch and perform these finite zero-inference mechanical checks. No new Max review, model canary, root phase approval or broader review pyramid; usable unrelated jobs continue.
